## Set 1: Distinct linear factors

*Similar to* $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x-1)(x+1)}\,dx$

1. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x-2)(x+3)}\,dx$

2. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x+1)(x+4)}\,dx$

3. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x-3)(x+3)}\,dx$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Answers — Set 1

1. $\dfrac{1}{(x-2)(x+3)} = \dfrac{1/5}{x-2} - \dfrac{1/5}{x+3}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(x-2)(x+3)}\,dx = \frac{1}{5}\ln\left|\frac{x-2}{x+3}\right| + C$$

2. $\dfrac{1}{(x+1)(x+4)} = \dfrac{1/3}{x+1} - \dfrac{1/3}{x+4}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(x+1)(x+4)}\,dx = \frac{1}{3}\ln\left|\frac{x+1}{x+4}\right| + C$$

3. $\dfrac{1}{(x-3)(x+3)} = \dfrac{1/6}{x-3} - \dfrac{1/6}{x+3}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(x-3)(x+3)}\,dx = \frac{1}{6}\ln\left|\frac{x-3}{x+3}\right| + C$$
:::

## Set 2: Repeated linear factor

*Similar to* $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x-1)^2(x+1)}\,dx$

Use the form $\dfrac{A}{x-a} + \dfrac{B}{(x-a)^2} + \dfrac{C}{x-b}$.

1. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x-2)^2(x+1)}\,dx$

2. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x+1)^2(x-3)}\,dx$

3. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{x^2(x+2)}\,dx$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Answers — Set 2

1. $A = -\tfrac{1}{9},\ B = \tfrac{1}{3},\ C = \tfrac{1}{9}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(x-2)^2(x+1)}\,dx = -\frac{1}{9}\ln|x-2| - \frac{1}{3(x-2)} + \frac{1}{9}\ln|x+1| + C$$

2. $A = -\tfrac{1}{16},\ B = -\tfrac{1}{4},\ C = \tfrac{1}{16}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(x+1)^2(x-3)}\,dx = -\frac{1}{16}\ln|x+1| + \frac{1}{4(x+1)} + \frac{1}{16}\ln|x-3| + C$$

3. $A = -\tfrac{1}{4},\ B = \tfrac{1}{2},\ C = \tfrac{1}{4}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{x^2(x+2)}\,dx = -\frac{1}{4}\ln|x| - \frac{1}{2x} + \frac{1}{4}\ln|x+2| + C$$
:::

## Set 3: Distinct linear factors, leading coefficient $\neq 1$

Watch the chain rule: $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{ax+b}\,dx = \frac{1}{a}\ln|ax+b| + C$.

1. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(2x-1)(x+1)}\,dx$

2. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(3x+2)(x-1)}\,dx$

3. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(2x+1)(3x-1)}\,dx$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Answers — Set 3

1. $\dfrac{1}{(2x-1)(x+1)} = \dfrac{2/3}{2x-1} - \dfrac{1/3}{x+1}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(2x-1)(x+1)}\,dx = \frac{1}{3}\ln\left|\frac{2x-1}{x+1}\right| + C$$

2. $\dfrac{1}{(3x+2)(x-1)} = -\dfrac{3/5}{3x+2} + \dfrac{1/5}{x-1}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(3x+2)(x-1)}\,dx = \frac{1}{5}\ln\left|\frac{x-1}{3x+2}\right| + C$$

3. $\dfrac{1}{(2x+1)(3x-1)} = -\dfrac{2/5}{2x+1} + \dfrac{3/5}{3x-1}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(2x+1)(3x-1)}\,dx = \frac{1}{5}\ln\left|\frac{3x-1}{2x+1}\right| + C$$
:::

## Set 4: Repeated linear factor, leading coefficient $\neq 1$

Use the form $\dfrac{A}{ax+b} + \dfrac{B}{(ax+b)^2} + \dfrac{C}{cx+d}$, and note $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(ax+b)^2}\,dx = -\frac{1}{a(ax+b)} + C$.

1. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(2x-1)^2(x+1)}\,dx$

2. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x-1)^2(3x+1)}\,dx$

3. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{x^2(2x+3)}\,dx$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Answers — Set 4

1. $\dfrac{A}{2x-1} + \dfrac{B}{(2x-1)^2} + \dfrac{C}{x+1}$ with $A = -\tfrac{2}{9},\ B = \tfrac{2}{3},\ C = \tfrac{1}{9}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(2x-1)^2(x+1)}\,dx = -\frac{1}{9}\ln|2x-1| - \frac{1}{3(2x-1)} + \frac{1}{9}\ln|x+1| + C$$

2. $\dfrac{A}{x-1} + \dfrac{B}{(x-1)^2} + \dfrac{C}{3x+1}$ with $A = -\tfrac{3}{16},\ B = \tfrac{1}{4},\ C = \tfrac{9}{16}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{(x-1)^2(3x+1)}\,dx = -\frac{3}{16}\ln|x-1| - \frac{1}{4(x-1)} + \frac{3}{16}\ln|3x+1| + C$$

3. $\dfrac{A}{x} + \dfrac{B}{x^2} + \dfrac{C}{2x+3}$ with $A = -\tfrac{2}{9},\ B = \tfrac{1}{3},\ C = \tfrac{4}{9}$
   $$\int \frac{1}{x^2(2x+3)}\,dx = -\frac{2}{9}\ln|x| - \frac{1}{3x} + \frac{2}{9}\ln|2x+3| + C$$
:::

## Extra Practice (no solutions)

A mix of all the types above. Some denominators need to be factored first.

1. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x-4)(x+2)}\,dx$

2. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{x^2-4x+3}\,dx$

3. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(3x-2)(x+2)}\,dx$

4. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{4x^2-1}\,dx$

5. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x+3)^2(x-1)}\,dx$

6. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{x(2x+1)^2}\,dx$

7. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{(x-2)^2(2x+1)}\,dx$

8. $\displaystyle\int \frac{1}{x^3-x^2}\,dx$
